verdicts.reason: A keeps the original composition intact (white card, frame, dots, correct reading order) but it is only a letterboxed shrink. White bands top and bottom waste space, and the card text is the same small size, so it fits the square format poorly. B is broken: a pink dot collides with the 'STUDIO' text, 'DDG STUDIO PRESENTS' sits below the headline, and the order is jumbled. The frame is a stray empty rectangle, the dot floats in it, and the tagline bar sticks out of the card edge. The opening line is cramped to the card edges and the card is oddly narrow and offset.
